description: This PHP source file defines the 'ResourceGroupsTaggingAPIClient' class, which extends the AwsClient class. It includes PHPDoc comments that document various methods for interacting with AWS Resource Groups Tagging API, such as describing report creation, fetching compliance summaries, managing resources, tags, and asynchronous variants of these methods.

classes.name: ResourceGroupsTaggingAPIClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Resource Groups Tagging API service, providing methods for managing resource tags, compliance, and report generation.

methods.name: describeReportCreation
methods.description: Fetches details about report creation status.

methods.name: describeReportCreationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches details about report creation status.

methods.name: getComplianceSummary
methods.description: Retrieves a summary of compliance metrics.

methods.name: getTagValues
methods.description: Returns all tag values for a specified key.
